release_notes:
v1.0.28+35 - Content-Level Streaming Rates & Dedicated Digital Guest Pass Architecture
- Dynamic Content Rates: Song tutorials and masterclasses directly supply their own 1-Hour Stream Pass, 2-Hours Practice Pass, and Full Lifetime Unlock prices.
- Purged Detached Pass Fluff: Eradicated detached generic time-pass cards in storefront; guests and students now directly browse real song tutorials and digital scores.
- Universal Duration Selector: Seamlessly integrated tutorial rates across public catalog, course syllabus previews, and in-session extensions.
